name: MCP Builder
description: Guide MCP server setup, Warp integration, and validation steps for new tools or services.

server_name.description: Name of the MCP server or external tool to integrate.

rules: Never output real API keys, tokens, private keys, or credentials.
Use placeholders and environment-variable references for authentication examples.
Require explicit user confirmation before overwriting existing MCP configuration or enabling an external service.
Identify paid, privileged, networked, or third-party data-processing effects before authorization.
stop_conditions: 授權、資料來源、範圍、身份或外部操作權限無法確認時停止高影響部分。
發現來源矛盾、敏感資料暴露、輸出無法驗證或任務目標漂移時停止並要求人工判斷。

positive_examples: 使用者明確要求：Guide MCP server setup, Warp integration, and validation steps for new tools or services.
negative_examples: 任務只涉及與「MCP Builder」無關的主題，不需要其專門流程。
exclude_when: 若任務不涉及「MCP Builder」的核心目的、輸入或輸出，不要啟用本技能。
activation.selection_notes: 先檢查任務目的、輸入資料與外部權限；相鄰技能重疊時以最小權限與最窄範圍優先。
